changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard format, merged duplicate T5 mentions, clarified outputs more precisely. Added 'Dialogue Generation' as this is a core task involving generating conversational sessions.

Removed all retrieval metrics (MRR, NDCG@3, Recall@20/100) as these evaluate retrieval performance, not NLG quality. The paper does not use automatic metrics to evaluate the generated conversational queries/sessions themselves.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The extracted metadata was correctly empty.
No human evaluation of the generated outputs is conducted in this paper. The paper only evaluates retrieval performance on downstream tasks.

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on retrieval system performance evaluation rather than NLG quality evaluation. While they do generate conversational queries/sessions, they only evaluate the downstream retrieval performance (MRR, NDCG, Recall) rather than the quality of the generated text itself. Proper NLG evaluation (automatic metrics, human evaluation, or LLM-as-judge) is not conducted.
